groups.title: Exterior Painting
groups.summary: Houston humidity, heavy rain and strong sun are hard on commercial coatings. South- and west-facing walls fade and chalk first from UV.
groups.intro: Houston humidity, heavy rain and strong sun are hard on commercial coatings. South- and west-facing walls fade and chalk first from UV. North elevations get little sun, stay damp and grow mildew, so they are cleaned and treated before any primer goes on. Paint applied over damp, chalky or mildewed surfaces loses adhesion and peels early.

groups.title: Drywall Repair
groups.summary: We use setting-type compound for deep fills and water-damaged areas, and lightweight compound for the finish coats.
groups.intro: We use setting-type compound for deep fills and water-damaged areas (it hardens chemically, so humidity doesn't stall it) and lightweight compound for the finish coats. We use drywall primer over new board and mud, and a stain-blocking primer over water stains so they don't bleed through.

about.title: About Houston Superior Painting
text: A Houston painting company built around preparation, written expectations and finishes designed for Houston conditions.
Juan Serra founded Houston Superior Painting in 2019 and is the company's owner. He runs it from our Cypress headquarters, and the company now serves Greater Houston from five offices.

The company was built on one idea: in Houston's heat and humidity, paint only lasts as long as the prep underneath it. That is why our estimates spell out the prep work line by line, and why our slogan is “Old-School Preparation. Premium Long-Lasting Results.”
